config.purpose: Retrospective transfer after all twelve records informed structure selection; no untouched-holdout claim

unknown_run.initial_state: Cold heater/sensor pairs conditioned on the first reported reading in each channel; no later test outputs fitted
unknown_run.conductance: Unknown ratio within the candidate hard band around the regressed training nominal; no population distribution inferred

config.prediction: Show free simulation and stationary marginal quantized-noise ranges separately from filtered one-step bin scores. Hard-nuisance envelopes are scenario ranges, not probability intervals over ambient/conductance. Parameter and model-form uncertainty remain explicit additional components.

reference_transport_sensitivity.added_after: Four primary protocol fits and canonical noise/scenario forecasts passed independent audits; nominal reference changes were identified when interpreting the omitted-protocol results.
reference_transport_sensitivity.scope: Primary leave-protocol-out folds only; an additional noise/scenario forecast, preserving all canonical forecasts and every training fit.
reference_transport_sensitivity.formula: For a hypothetical original centered N=12 cohort with deltas in [log(1-b),log(1+b)], the omitted run's ratio to the retained m-run geometric nominal lies in [(1-b)^(N/m),(1+b)^(N/m)] when both extreme assignments are feasible.
reference_transport_sensitivity.limitations: Forecast stress check with no fitted test nuisance values. Original training constraints stay unchanged, so this is not a transported cohort likelihood or a corrected coverage calibration. The all-data fit is only an explicitly retrospective reference diagnostic; it does not choose these bounds.

weak_curvature_refinement.trigger: A terminal independent information audit confirms nonpositive observed curvature at an accepted transfer fit; no covariance or draws accepted
weak_curvature_refinement.protocol: Additional unconstrained nuisance/mean/noise fits from loading seeds spanning the original bounds, with the usual sensor/input-lag branch exchange. Original fit remains a selection candidate; select lowest successful nll, not positive curvature. Preserve every attempt and independently audit the selected fit, then recompute information. No bound snapping, eigenvalue clipping, tolerance relaxation or test-output fitting.

parameter_mixture_sensitivity.method: Independently audited observed-bin Hessian, local normal on the selected active-bound face, truncated by remaining box bounds; profile/model/initial sensitivities reported separately
parameter_mixture_sensitivity.calibration: No automatic total 95% or posterior interpretation. Active coordinates are fixed, disconnected profiles excluded; require a positive audited face Hessian and source-bound draw receipt. Compare coarse/fine propagated ranges and report their numerical change before interpreting them.

attempts.role: Original independently audited fit; retained as a candidate

curvature_refinement.notice: Selection is by successful objective value only, never by covariance definiteness. Selected-point and new information audits remain required.

notice: Single-fold additional-start investigation after nonpositive curvature. Original collection/fit/forecasts are unchanged. This selected point is not an accepted uncertainty result until its independent selected-point and information audits pass.
